analogy.rationale: Bile acids are endogenous FXR ligands, so FXR agonists should mimic their transcriptional program; bile acids also crosstalk with sterol/lipid nuclear receptors (LXR, PPAR, CAR) and feedback on cholesterol synthesis, though the annotated targets here are mitochondrial/OXPHOS and CES1/ADH1C rather than canonical nuclear receptors, predicting generally weak responses in these cell lines.
